channel.title: Orthopedics This Week - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Orthopedics This Week (ryortho.com)

item.title: Life Spine Announces Expanded Indications for ARx® SAI Spinal Fixation System - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Life Spine, Inc. announced their 510k for ARx SAI (Sacral Alar Iliac) Spinal Fixation System was approved.

item.title: Organogenesis Completes Rolling Submission of Biologics License Application for ReNu® - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Organogenesis Holdings announced the completion of a rolling Biologics License Application (BLA) submission to the FDA for ReNu®, a cryopreserved, amniotic suspension allograft developed for the management of symptomatic knee osteoarthritis (OA).

item.title: PRP vs. Steroids in the Rotator Cuff: A Slow Burn Beats a Quick Hit - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Will this study end the corticosteroid vs PRP debate? Maybe not, but it sure gives PRP advocates new ammunition.

item.title: Theradaptive Secures FDA Approval to Advance OASIS Trial to Pivotal Study Evaluating OsteoAdapt® SP in Spinal Fusion - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Theradaptive, Inc. today announced that the U.S. FDA has granted approval for the Company to initiate the pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating OsteoAdapt® SP, its next-generation regenerative therapeutic for spinal fusion procedures.

item.title: Stryker Launches Trident II Acetabular System in India for Advancing Hip Replacement Surgeries - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Stryker, a global leader in medical technologies, announced the launch of the Trident II Acetabular System in India.

item.title: Knee Rehab Goes Digital: Can Telerehabilitation Keep Up After TKA? - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: For decades, the postoperative pathway after total knee arthroplasty (TKA) has been pretty standard.

item.title: Dana C. Covey, M.D. Honored With OREF Award - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Dana Covey, M.D. and Captain in the United States Navy Medical Corps (Ret.) is the 2026 OREF Research award winner.

item.title: First Subjects Randomized in Clinical Trial Evaluating the Benefits of Total Segmental Fusion in Treating Degenerative Conditions in the Lumbar Spine - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Providence Medical Technology’s latest randomized controlled trial is designed to once again challenge the standard of care in spinal fusion surgery.

item.title: Kelsey H. Collins, Ph.D. Wins Award for Novel OA Research - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Kelsey H. Collins Ph.D. is the 2026 winner of the prestigious AAOS and ORS award for novel osteoarthritis (OA) research.

item.title: Humeral Shaft Fractures: When the Plate Beats the Brace - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: New study out of Finland, called FISH (yes, really) compared bracing to surgery for humeral shaft fracture. The endpoint? Cost.

item.title: Dual Mobility vs. Jumbo Heads in Primary THA - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Dual mobility hip or a jumbo head. Which provides better, long-term stability?

item.title: ERAS: Everyone Loves the Idea…But Who’s Actually Doing It? - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) really works, per a new AOSpine study. Lower opioid use. Faster recovery. Better outcomes.

item.title: Vy Spine Announces FDA Clearance for DiversiVy™ Facet Screw - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: VySpine,announced today that it has received 510(k) clearance from the FDA for the its DiversiVy™ Facet Screw System.

item.title: SINTX Technologies Provides Corporate Business Update Highlighting First Human Implant, Strategic Transformation, and Commercial Execution - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: SINTX Technologies, Inc. provided a corporate business update highlighting recent clinical, operational, and leadership milestones.

item.title: Fat Map Strikes Back: Best Infection Predictor in Lumbar Fusion - Orthopedics This Week
item.description: A new fat stat might finally give surgeons a clinically relevant measure for back pain patients.
